subject: Redwood + Nimbus SI bundle — ops dependencies and sprint asks
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@nimbo-sys.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-09T09:12:00Z
Subject: Integration planning: Redwood + Nimbus SI bundle (ops dependencies)

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week — Nimbus is excited about bundling Redwood Inference into our SI-managed offering. Before we lock the mutual action plan, our ops team needs to confirm a couple of hard dependencies that affect pricing and rollout timing. High level asks: 

- Can Redwood support a VPC-private control plane + on-prem inference nodes (short-term PoC)?
- What are supported quantization/FP options for the 30B family (INT8/4)? Any official profiles?
- Auditability: can we provide per-tenant audit logs and token retention controls for regulated customers?

We put an initial requirements doc together (attached). Can your engineering/Product folks do a quick triage and tell us which items are blockers vs. negotiable? Nimbus is targeting a joint pilot in Q4 and we need to align on the sprint dependencies.

Attachments: nimbus-integration-requirements.pdf (11 pages)

Cheers,
Samira Khan
Head of Partnerships, Nimbus Systems
partners@nimbo-sys.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-10T14:27:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Integration planning: Redwood + Nimbus SI bundle (ops dependencies)

Thanks — quick technical read after skimming the attached PDF. Triage notes below (rough; we should spin up a short sync to validate):

Blockers (would require engineering sprints):
- VPC-private control plane + air-gapped on-prem inference: we support customer-controlled VPC for private deployments, but the current upstream control plane we ship needs minor adjustments for Nimbus's preferred bootstrap (they want pre-seeded images and no outbound control-plane telemetry). Estimated 3 sprint effort (infra + security review) for a hardened PoC.
- Per-tenant audit logs with token-level retention controls: we have audit logs but not per-tenant token redaction/retention policies in the UI. Requires work on metadata tagging and retention config (2 sprints).

Negotiable / lower effort:
- INT8 quantization profiles for the 30B variants: we have experimental INT8 profiles for 30B but not fully validated across all third-party forks; engineering can produce a verified profile for Nimbus in 1 sprint if we prioritize.
- KV cache sharing semantics for multi-tenant SI deployments: minor runtime config change + docs.

Attachments referenced: proposed-map-ma-plan.xlsx (I added estimated sprint counts)

Action: recommend a 30-minute sync with Nimbus ops + our infra lead to confirm telemetry requirements and signing process for pre-seeded images.

-Karthik
VP, Integrations

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-11T09:08:00Z
Subject: Re: Integration planning: Redwood + Nimbus SI bundle (ops dependencies)

Good triage. A few product/ops notes from my side: 

- Marketplace gating: if Nimbus will market via a marketplace (AWS, GCP marketplaces), we need a standard listing package plus a liability/entitlement check. That process can add 6 weeks if they require marketplace-managed billing.
- Pricing model: for SI bundles we typically offer a blended reserved commit + overage model. Rachel, can you confirm whether Nimbus wants a co-selling list price or a channel rebate structure? That affects how we present the MA/PS scope in the MAP.
- Compliance: Aditya, we should confirm if Nimbus's regulated customers will require SOC2 Type II evidence and whether our Private deployment attestation is sufficient.

I've dropped a draft MAP + sprint breakdown into the shared Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/nimbus-integration/requirements (see tab "MAP_v1"). Also attaching a stub (signature-stub-docusign.pdf) we can send once legal is happy.

-LB
Product Manager, Marketplace & Integrations

From: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-11T16:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Integration planning: Redwood + Nimbus SI bundle (ops dependencies)

Samira — thanks for the doc. Quick summary and next steps from our side: 

Summary of blockers:
- Hardened private control plane + pre-seeded on-prem images (approx. 3 sprints)
- Per-tenant audit log retention controls (approx. 2 sprints)

Lower-effort items:
- INT8 profile validation for 30B (1 sprint)
- KV cache tenancy docs/config (0.5 sprint)

Proposed next steps:
1) 30-min technical sync — Wed 2028-07-13 @ 15:00 PT (Karthik + Nimbus ops + our infra). Please confirm.
2) We'll circulate a MAP v1 (attached: proposed-map-ma-plan.xlsx) with sprint estimates, owner mapping, and a draft billing model.
3) If Nimbus wants marketplace listing, flag now — adds ~6 weeks for listing/entitlement work.
4) I'll loop legal (Aditya) on the DocuSign stub once Nimbus confirms the commercial model.

Attachments: proposed-map-ma-plan.xlsx, signature-stub-docusign.pdf

Looking forward — Rachel
